## Highlights

- Refine Limits in Desktop and TUI: show the provider before the update time, use icon-only quota and period rows, give the two scales one outer rounded contour, and keep reset-time switching on its own row.
- Show Codex's native account credit balance without mixing it with Banked Resets. Preserve the provider's precision, explicit zero and unlimited state; missing balances remain unknown.
- Keep existing idle child sessions visible in Recent when their execution happened before monitoring started. Do not invent run timing or outcomes; Desktop opens Recent when Active is empty and recent children exist.

## Upgrade notes

Restart OpenCode after updating Navigator. The existing Navigator Corners font requirement and Text fallback are unchanged.

releases.name: v0.27.6 — Compact Limits and reset-time switching
releases.body:
## Highlights

- Limits is more compact in Desktop and TUI: window icons and quota values sit above the adjacent quota and blue period scales, with native provider credit balances below.
- Reset time appears once. Activate its swap-icon row to switch between the relative countdown and absolute reset date/time, without refreshing the provider.
- The selected time format survives quota refreshes. Keyboard users can press Enter in TUI, or Enter/Space on Desktop's native button; missing and invalid dates remain explicit.

## Upgrade notes

- Restart existing OpenCode clients after the Navigator update to ensure they load the new plugin. No OpenCode or theme update is required.
- Quota pace thresholds, provider-native balance units, Banked Resets and confirmed credit consumption are unchanged.
- The Navigator Corners font requirement for rounded multiline terminal selections is unchanged.

releases.name: v0.27.5 — Quota pace, reset cards and reliable updates
releases.body:
## Highlights

- Two Limits scales show quota remaining and blue time remaining, with live reset countdowns and yellow/orange/red pace warnings when quota falls behind the period.
- Banked Resets show their available count and compact, icon-led credit cards. Provider details stay available on demand, and spending a credit still needs separate confirmation.
- Desktop sidebar sections have native icons alongside independent disclosure arrows.
- About keeps checking, the update offer, progress and restart guidance in one place. Exact npm pins and the historical server plugin ID no longer produce false-current or missing-plugin results.
- ChatGPT token-sharing connections can explicitly link a verified Codex account; native confirmation results and externally opened dialogs are preserved.

## Upgrade notes

- Restart OpenCode after the update to load the new Navigator version. OpenCode host versions, themes and unrelated settings do not need to change.
- If an older exact-pinned Navigator cannot update itself, replace its existing `opencode-navigator@...` entry with `opencode-navigator@0.27.5` in the same configuration scope. Do not add a duplicate plugin entry or replace a file/snapshot installation with an npm source.
- Period percentages and pace warnings require provider-supplied reset timestamps and window duration. Missing data stays explicit; the countdown does not increase provider polling.
- The existing Navigator Corners font requirement for rounded multiline TUI selections is unchanged.

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at e0ca9a5e4610f08c6b8c5071e6e9a3951f7883e4 -->

## What's Changed
* Add "chatgpt-token-sharing" way of getting ChatGPT remaining limits by @laralex in https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/pull/36
* Refine quota displays, reset cards and Navigator updates by @St1ggy in https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/pull/46

## New Contributors
* @laralex made their first contribution in https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/pull/36

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/compare/v0.27.4...v0.27.5

## Highlights

- See banked-reset expiry progress in the terminal, with readable remaining time and explicit missing or invalid dates. Spending a credit still requires a separate confirmation.
- Manage Desktop MCP connections with native switches for individual servers, whole groups and Search Everything results. Keep bookmarks, pending feedback and separate error information.
- Find Desktop settings in Layout, Behavior, Quick Actions, Skills, MCP, Presets and About categories without losing unfinished drafts or scoped preferences. Left/Right follows the currently focused category button.

## Upgrade notes

- Favorites, account bindings, pending reset attempts, presets and existing preferences are preserved. Reset credits are never consumed automatically.
- The verified host targets remain OpenCode 1.19.5 and 2.2.6. This release does not upgrade OpenCode itself.
- No font revision is needed for this update. Terminal users should keep their primary Nerd Font and the additional Navigator Corners font for rounded multiline selections; Text fallback remains available without the corner font. See the README for installation instructions.
- Reopen clients after updating Navigator if an already loaded plugin still reports the previous version.

## What's Changed

## Highlights

- Keep long Desktop session titles readable on a separate full-width row in the sidebar and floating mini-window.
- Use native icon buttons and tooltips for familiar sidebar actions, including Search, Refresh, Settings, Float, Dock and information. Keep text for Banked Resets, account linking and other less obvious operations.
- Keep successful Desktop Limits compact: show the update time and quota data without a persistent account/model scope explanation. Errors, sign-in guidance and reset-credit safeguards are preserved.

## Upgrade notes

- Existing toolbar pin appearances, favorites, account bindings and scoped preferences are preserved.
- The verified host targets remain OpenCode 1.19.5 and 2.2.6. This release does not upgrade OpenCode itself.
- Reopen clients if their existing plugin instance still reports the previous Navigator version.
- Terminal users should keep their primary Nerd Font and the additional Navigator Corners font for rounded multiline selections. Install the bundled corner font on the machine displaying the terminal and fully restart the terminal after font changes; Text mode remains available without it.
